principles: The raw observation table contains no baseline fitted across all rows.
Identifiers, quality fields, manual window bounds and post-action consequences are never pre-action decision features.
The physical action ratio is lift lead versus a fold-fitted push brake onset divided by fold-fitted push deceleration distance.
Planned action and executed action remain separate. Historical executed action may fit a response surface; live inference supplies a planned action.
Any dynamic context feature must satisfy feature timestamp <= decision cutoff before it can enter a decision model.
Acceleration at a proposed lift is derived from fold-local clean-push traces at the same physical lead ratio, never from the held-out LICO passage.

column_groups.default_definition: Lineage or grouping identifier; forbidden as a model input.
Context known before the session; use only when the evaluation regime can identify its effect.
Manual capture or display metadata; never used to normalize the physical action.
Collection design metadata used for filtering and audit, not prediction.
Dynamic value sampled near zone entry; unavailable to decision models until its timestamp is proven no later than the decision cutoff.
Timestamp or verification flag enforcing feature time <= decision time.
Requested lift start for live inference; null for historical runs without a surviving lap-zone plan.
Treatment actually executed; never substituted silently for a live planned action.
Legacy threshold/window-derived diagnostic retained for backward comparison; forbidden in the decision feature view.
Observed same-pass consequence; never a same-pass pre-action predictor.
Metric from the main sustained braking event and first relevant minimum-speed point.
Filter, review or readiness information; forbidden as a predictor.

derived_inside_each_fold.definition: Forward along-track distance from planned lift start to the median push brake onset.
Forward along-track distance from executed lift start to the median push brake onset.
Planned lift lead divided by median push braking onset-to-minimum-speed distance.
Executed lift lead divided by median push braking onset-to-minimum-speed distance.
Acceleration at the proposed lift point, interpolated from fold-local clean-push profiles at physical lead ratios 0.5, 1.0 and 1.5.
Fold-local clean-push acceleration interpolated at the executed action ratio; it does not use acceleration observed after the LICO action.
Planned lift ratio multiplied by non-negative fold-local push acceleration at that point.
Executed lift ratio multiplied by non-negative fold-local push acceleration at that point.
Whether the planned action ratio is inside the push acceleration grid or clipped below/above it.
Whether the executed action ratio is inside the push acceleration grid or clipped below/above it.
Fold-fitted median push fuel use minus observed zone fuel use.
Observed zone time minus fold-fitted median push zone time.
